metadata.scenario_context: The school is hosting an academic discussion about immigration. Mike, Kim, and Emily are planning to meet at a set time to attend the event together.

cultural_axis.agent_1_value: People from China strongly disagree that the government should place strict limits on the number of foreigners who can come here.
cultural_axis.agent_2_value: People from Malaysia strongly agree that the government should place strict limits on the number of foreigners who can come here.

agent_1.goal_1: Discuss asking Emily to join at the agreed-upon time.
agent_1.goal_2: Question whether strongly agree that the government should place strict limits on the number of foreigners who go to their countries.

agent_2.goal_1: Discuss the time to meet and attend the event together.
agent_2.goal_2: Discuss how immigration impacts social security.

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message:
Hey Kim, are we still meeting up with Emily at the agreed time for the academic discussion? I think it’ll be a good opportunity for us to share our perspectives. 

By the way, what do you think about the idea of the government placing strict limits on the number of foreigners coming into our countries? I really don’t agree with that stance.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Kim
shared_prefix.message:
Yeah, we should still meet up with Emily at the agreed time. I think it's important to share our perspectives, especially on a topic like immigration. 

As for the government placing strict limits on foreigners, I believe it's necessary. Too many foreigners can create issues for social security and resources. We need to protect our own citizens first.
shared_prefix.label: transition

shared_prefix.speaker: Mike
shared_prefix.message: I understand your perspective, Kim. But I think, deep down, we are all the same. Immigration can enrich our societies and help us all grow. People are pretty much motivated by the same things—security, opportunity, and community. Embracing diversity can actually strengthen our own cultures. When you really get to know people, they're pretty much like us, wanting the same things for their families. It's worth considering that different viewpoints can lead to a more balanced understanding.
